summary: MCP server exposes only 4 project.* tools (open/close/info/list_binaries/save). Validator tests pure helpers (sha256_hex, shannon_entropy, classify_binary, get_migrations, unix_to_iso8601, version_snapshot_pruning) NONE of which are exposed via MCP. Direct output comparison only possible for project.info / project.list_binaries on an empty state.

project.open(dir=testproj2).text: execution failed: cannot read .../testproj2: Accesso negato. (os error 5)
project.open(dir=testproj2).note: MCP project.open expects a binary FILE path, not a project directory; mismatches doc which says 'open a project'

mismatches.detail: Pure helpers sha256_hex, shannon_entropy, classify_binary, get_migrations, unix_to_iso8601, version_snapshot_pruning are not exposed via any MCP tool — cannot be cross-checked at runtime.

project.open description says 'Open a binary project from a filesystem path' but the implementation rejects directory paths and requires a binary file, whereas Project::new/open in rustre-project takes a directory. Tool description is misleading.

notes: Validator self-tests all pass against reference values; the 2 mismatches are coverage/contract observations, not numerical disagreements between MCP and validator on shared inputs. No code fix attempted because no shared input/output pair produced divergent results.
